description: AM Group has partnered with Uttar Pradesh to establish a $25 billion high-performance computing hub in Greater Noida, projected to offer significant economic impact and job creation while prioritizing sustainability.
body_lead: AM Group signs MoU with Uttar Pradesh to build $25 billion AI compute hub The proposed project will be developed in phases, with the first capacity expected to come online in 2028 and the full 1 GW targeted by 2030. The AM Group on Tuesday said it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Invest UP, the Uttar Pradesh government’s investment promotion agency, to set up a 1 gigawatt (GW) high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) hub in Greater Noida.
